insight.topCategory: Your biggest spending category this month was {{category}}, at <amount>{{amount}}</amount> ({{percentage}} of your spending).

details.title: Technical detail
details.uncategorized: The aggregator sent no category for this transaction — that's what this modal is for.
details.duplicate: There's an identical record (same description, amount and time). Only one of the two counts toward the total.
details.pending: Pending confirmation, but already included in this month's total.
details.disputed: Disputed — excluded from the total while it's resolved.
details.foreignCurrency: Original charge of {{native}}, converted to {{converted}} at a fixed exchange rate for the total.
details.refund: Refund — it subtracts from its category instead of adding as income.
details.correctedSign: The amount arrived as unsigned text and was interpreted as an expense.
details.zeroAmount: Zero amount — it affects neither this month's income nor its expenses.

filters.activeNotice: Filters search the whole month, not just the visible week.

empty.noRows: There are no transactions in this period.
